description: Read-only: score a built network 0–100 on a fixed rubric (palette/motion/complexity/errors/perf) and return per-criterion sub-scores plus deterministic improvement suggestions. Optional LLM critique when llmCritique=true and ctx.llm is configured. Composes existing bridge endpoints — creates nothing.

criteria.description: Subset of rubric criteria to evaluate. Final score is the equal-weight mean of the selected ones.

llmCritique.description: When true and ctx.llm is configured, attach a short paragraph of artist-readable critique. Best-effort: LLM failure never fails the tool.

previewTopPath.description: Override the TOP sampled for palette/motion. Defaults to the first /scopePath/out* TOP, then any /scopePath/*_out TOP.

scopePath.description: Network root to score. Defaults to /project1.

targetFps.description: FPS target used to derive the perf budget (same semantics as get_td_performance).

name: score_build

final.description: Equal-weight mean of returned per-criterion scores, rounded.

perCriterion.description: Sub-scores for the criteria that were requested AND could be measured. Missing keys are reported in warnings.

title: Score a TouchDesigner build
